archetypes.name: harness-integrity
archetypes.rationale: The plan specifies elaborate, multi-constraint harness designs (CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT stub trees, fallback-forcing mechanics, merged 2>&1 captures) that could silently false-green if any one construction detail is wrong; no static archetype audits whether the proposed harness design would actually trigger the changed code paths rather than bypassing them.
archetypes.prompt_body: For each new test harness described in the plan, verify that the proposed construction would actually exercise the code path under test rather than producing a false-green. Check whether the fallback-forcing mechanic for ship-pr.sh (chmod -x on the helper vs clearing IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR) correctly satisfies the branch predicate at the target line range. Verify that the CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT stub tree layout required for collect-findings.sh (stub scripts/collect-agent-results.sh and scripts/wait-for-reviewers.sh under a synthetic root, plus real lib-quiet.sh and redact-secrets.sh siblings) matches the hardcoded path patterns the production script actually uses. Confirm that every harness case which asserts a stderr-emitted larch_err message uses merged 2>&1 capture rather than stdout-only assignment or LARCH_QUIET_DISABLE=1 alone. Verify the plan-review ancestor race layout (round-1/findings-classification.tsv with ANCESTOR_RACE_PARENT set to the physical round-1 directory) passes the allowlist regex before reaching the ancestor guard, and that the stub does not fall through to exec the real find after the directory swap. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: line-ref-staleness
archetypes.rationale: The plan cites approximately 20 specific line-number ranges across 8+ existing files; if any have shifted in current main the implementer will patch the wrong location, potentially leaving the actual target untouched while silently corrupting surrounding code.
archetypes.prompt_body: Read each in-scope file and verify that the plan's approximate line citations actually point to the constructs they describe: the three [[ -L "$f" ]] leaf checks in design-log-publish.sh's plan-review, render-cache, and .completed staging loops; the append_tool_failure_local fallback relay larch_err loops in ship-pr.sh; the collector_log and wait_log relay loops in collect-findings.sh; the aggregate_stderr relay block in review-core.sh; and the sanitize_diagnostic_line single-line-strip contract comment in lib-quiet.sh. Flag any citation that is off by more than 10 lines or that points to a structurally different construct than described. Also verify that make_find_symlink_race_stub exists near line 142 of test-design-log-publish.sh with the shape the plan says make_find_ancestor_race_stub should mirror (swap + printf + exit 0 + else exec pattern), since the new stub's correctness depends on that model. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
